title: Allow 1:1 meetings in Tempelhof room
description: Sales wants to book the big room A2-10 (Tempelhof) for 1:1 customer calls because of the good video equipment. Currently rejected with ROOM-422-BIG-ROOM.
resolution: Rejected by facility management. The big room policy (12+ seats need at least 4 attendees) stays. Use A1-01 (Spree) which also has video.

title: Bookings between 07:00 and 08:00 rejected after DST switch
description: Since the switch to daylight saving time, bookings starting between 07:00 and 08:00 local time fail with ROOM-422-HOURS.
resolution: Business hours are now checked in the office timezone instead of UTC (ADR-0004). Fixed in 2.1.0.

title: Bookings released although people are in the room
description: In room B2-14 (Wannsee) bookings are released after 10 minutes although the meeting takes place. The door display of the room is offline, so nobody can check in.
workaround: Check in via Slack with '/room checkin <booking id>'.

title: Users receive two release emails
description: After the scaling of the API to 3 replicas users get every 'booking released' email twice.
resolution: ROOMIE_RUN_SCHEDULER=1 was set on two replicas. Fixed in the deployment config, runbook updated.

title: 500 Internal Server Error when creating a booking without timezone
description: POST /api/v2/bookings answers with 500 instead of 422 if start/end are sent without timezone offset, e.g. '2026-03-03T10:00:00'. Comparing the naive datetime with the timezone-aware 'now' raises a TypeError. Reported by the mobile app team.
workaround: Always send timestamps with offset (e.g. '+01:00') or 'Z'.

title: Recurring bookings
description: Teams want to book a room for their weekly meeting in one step instead of creating every booking manually. Max. 8 weeks in advance (MAX_ADVANCE_DAYS = 60).

title: Show the reason in release notifications
description: The email 'Your booking was released' should explain the no-show policy and link to the check-in options.

title: Availability view ignores weekends
description: GET /rooms/{room_id}/availability returns free slots for Saturday and Sunday although rooms cannot be booked on weekends.

title: Replace demo API keys in config.py
description: The demo keys in roomie/config.py must only be used locally. Load the keys from the secret store in production and remove the fallback.
